title: Забытый зонт
scene: A woman leaves her umbrella on the tram and gets it back from an unexpected place.

segments.text: Вчера утром Аня ехала на работу на трамвае.
segments.text_en: Yesterday morning Anya was riding the tram to work.

segments.text: На улице шёл сильный дождь, и все пассажиры держали зонты.
segments.text_en: It was raining hard outside, and all the passengers were holding umbrellas.

segments.text: Аня читала книгу и не заметила свою остановку.
segments.text_en: Anya was reading a book and did not notice her stop.

segments.text: Она быстро вышла и только на улице поняла, что забыла зонт.
segments.text_en: She got off quickly and only outside realised that she had forgotten her umbrella.

segments.text: Вечером она позвонила в бюро находок, но там ничего не было.
segments.text_en: In the evening she called the lost property office, but there was nothing there.

segments.text: На следующий день Аня пришла в свою кофейню на углу.
segments.text_en: The next day Anya came to her coffee shop on the corner.

segments.text: Бариста улыбнулся и показал на синий зонт около кассы.
segments.text_en: The barista smiled and pointed at a blue umbrella near the till.

segments.text: Оказалось, что водитель трамвая тоже пьёт здесь кофе каждое утро.
segments.text_en: It turned out that the tram driver also drinks coffee here every morning.

glossary.gloss: to get off, to go out (perfective of выходить)
near the till, by the counter

grammar_spotlights.excerpt: Аня читала книгу и не заметила свою остановку
grammar_spotlights.explanation: Imperfective читала for the ongoing background, perfective заметила for the single missed event.
ехать for travelling by vehicle in one direction, with на plus prepositional for the means.

questions.question: Почему Аня не заметила свою остановку?
questions.explanation: The text says she was reading a book and did not notice her stop.

questions.question: Что Аня забыла в трамвае?
questions.explanation: Only outside did she realise she had forgotten her umbrella.

questions.question: Что ответили в бюро находок?
questions.explanation: She called in the evening, but there was nothing there.

questions.question: Как зонт попал в кофейню?
choices: Его нашёл другой пассажир на улице
questions.explanation: The last sentence implies the tram driver, who drinks coffee there every morning, brought it.
